recover.title: 小口喝水并滤过尿
recover.body: 急性期可以小口补水，用滤网或干净纱布滤过尿液。侧卧休息，热敷后腰。发热加腰痛或完全无尿时要立刻就医。这不是处方剂量。
recover.bodyEn: In the acute phase, sip fluids and strain urine with a sieve or clean gauze. Rest on the side and use heat on the back. Fever with flank pain or no urine at all means seek emergency care now. This is not a prescription dose.

recover.title: 侧卧休息与热敷
recover.body: 绞痛来时，百科常写侧卧、减少剧烈活动。热敷后腰是舒适措施，不是手术。若呕吐导致无法补水，要去急诊。休息不是惩罚。
recover.bodyEn: During colic, encyclopedias often describe lying on the side and cutting hard activity. Heat on the back is comfort, not an operation. Vomiting that blocks fluids means seek emergency care. Rest is not punishment.

recover.title: 排出期继续滤过
recover.titleEn: Keep straining while a stone may pass
recover.body: 可能自行排出的阶段，继续滤过尿液，把砂粒留下来。小口喝水，避免脱水。疼痛突然消失但完全无尿，仍要立刻就医。这不是诊断。
recover.bodyEn: In a phase when a stone may pass, keep straining urine and save grit. Sip fluids and avoid dehydration. If pain vanishes but there is no urine at all, seek emergency care now. This is not a diagnosis.

recover.title: 碎石后的休息窗
recover.body: 体外冲击波之后，常见建议是休息、小口补水、滤过尿液。血尿可以出现几天。发热、寒战或无法喝水要立刻急诊。不要自行加大处方药剂量。
recover.bodyEn: After shock-wave lithotripsy, common encyclopedia lines are rest, sip fluids, and strain urine. Blood-tinged urine can last a few days. Fever, shaking chills, or blocked fluids mean seek emergency care. Do not raise a prescription dose on your own.

recover.title: 输尿管镜后的几天
recover.body: 输尿管镜后可能留置支架。休息、滤过尿液、按约定复诊。尿急和腰胀被写成常见不适。发热或无尿要立刻就医。这不是处方。
recover.bodyEn: A stent may stay after ureteroscopy. Rest, strain urine, and keep the review. Urgency and a dull flank ache are written as common discomfort. Fever or no urine means seek emergency care. This is not a prescription.

recover.title: 预防段落里的液体
recover.body: 预防词条把足量液体写在前面。目标是尿液不要长期过浓。这是生活百科，不是惩罚。柠檬酸盐和盐的讨论要放在化验之后。这不是诊断。
recover.bodyEn: Prevention entries put enough fluid first. The aim is urine that is not concentrated for long stretches. Lifestyle encyclopedia, not punishment. Citrate and salt talk belongs after assays. This is not a diagnosis.

recover.title: 什么时候去急诊
recover.titleEn: When encyclopedias say seek emergency care
recover.body: 红旗包括发热加腰痛、完全无尿、怀孕期间剧痛、呕吐到无法补水。百科写的是就医时机。不要在家给自己下病名。先保证安全和液体。
recover.bodyEn: Red flags include fever with flank pain, no urine at all, severe pain in pregnancy, and vomiting that blocks fluids. Encyclopedias write timing for emergency care. Do not name a disease at home. Safety and fluids come first.

recover.title: 慢慢走动帮助等待
recover.body: 有些词条提到在能忍受时慢慢走动。这不是比赛。继续小口喝水、滤过尿液。疼痛让人无法站立或出现发热，就停止走动去急诊。
recover.bodyEn: Some entries mention slow walking if it can be tolerated. This is not a race. Keep sipping fluids and straining urine. If pain prevents standing or fever appears, stop walking and seek emergency care.

recover.title: 碎石后继续补水
recover.body: 碎石后砂粒要排出，液体和滤过仍然重要。休息几天，不要立刻猛跑。冲击波设备照片只说明场景。发热要立刻就医。
recover.bodyEn: After lithotripsy, fragments still need to leave. Fluids and straining remain important. Rest a few days. Do not sprint immediately. Device photos only set the scene. Fever means seek emergency care now.

recover.title: 带着支架的恢复
recover.titleEn: Recovery while a stent is in place
recover.body: 支架可能引起尿频和腰胀。休息、滤过尿液、按医嘱时间取出。不要自行剪支架。无法排尿或高热要立刻急诊。这不是诊断。
recover.bodyEn: A stent may cause frequency and a dull ache. Rest, strain urine, and keep the planned removal. Do not cut a stent at home. Inability to pass urine or high fever means seek emergency care. This is not a diagnosis.

recover.title: 柠檬水作为饮食讨论
recover.body: 柠檬和柑橘出现在柠檬酸盐的饮食讨论里。它不能代替化验和足量液体。预防还包括减少长时间脱水。这不是特效药说明书。
recover.bodyEn: Lemon and citrus show up in citrate diet talk. They do not replace assays or enough fluid. Prevention also includes fewer long dry stretches. This is not a miracle-drug label.

recover.title: 先躺下再决定下一步
recover.titleEn: Lie down first, then decide the next step
recover.body: 剧痛时先侧卧、小口喝水、准备滤过尿液。如果出现发热、无尿或吐到喝不进，就转为急诊路径。休息是第一步，不是放弃。
recover.bodyEn: In severe pain, lie on the side, sip fluids, and prepare to strain urine. Fever, no urine, or vomiting that blocks fluids turns the path toward emergency care. Rest is a first step, not giving up.
